snippet.title: Bad Sector ³  | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🔗 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798290/Bad_Sector/

Bad Sector ³ is a psychological horror game of observation and judgment where every mistake costs you ground.

Advance both horizontally and vertically through a labyrinth of rooms that look almost identical. Almost...

Spot the anomalies and decide if the sector is corrupted. A wrong choice pushes you back. Three, and you fall.

Your fate rests only on your perception and your conviction.

🔸 Three difficulty levels to test your tolerance for error.
🔸 A cycle you must try to break or be doomed to wander forever.

You will deny. You will doubt. But eventually... you will accept your destiny.
